question: What claim about the scope of yoginīs is at stake in relating all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs to a single group of fields?
premises: All earth-moving yoginīs are in view.
All sky-moving yoginīs are in view.
Both classes are related to the all-field group.
inference: The all-field group comprises or pertains to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
uncertainties: The exact relation between the yoginīs and the field group is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: The all-field group belongs to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
